setup.zh: 筑基第二天夜里，观主摊开舆图，指头按在北边一条弯弯的墨线上：邺城年年给河伯娶妇。二十来天后，你、周衡，还有石阶底下蹲着的阿禾，北上到了漳水边。
setup.en: The night after your Foundation, the abbot unrolls a map and presses a finger on a winding ink line in the north: every year the city of Ye gives the River Lord a bride. Some twenty days later you, Zhou Heng, and A-He — found squatting at the foot of the steps — reach the Zhang.

recap.zh: 北上到了漳水，对岸是邺城；周衡望着河心那片最深的水，一个字也没记。
recap.en: North to the Zhang, Ye on the far bank; Zhou Heng stared at the deepest water mid-river and wrote down not a word.

zh: 黄里带青，一眼望不到底。
周衡的账簿合着，一个字也没记。
en: The tenth evening, at the Zhang.
Yellow shot with green, no seeing the bottom.
Zhou Heng's ledger stays shut; not one word.

story.zh:
第十天傍晚，三人到了漳水边上。

那漳水比泗水宽，也比泗水浑，黄里带青，一眼望不到底，水面上平平的，几乎瞧不出它在流，只偶尔翻起一个漩涡，打个转，又沉了下去。

阿禾「哇」了一声，小狰冲着河面「嗷」了一声，小满也想说句什么，一回头，却见周衡站在岸上，不动了。

小满道：「周师兄？」周衡道：「嗯。」

这一回，他竟没说「记账」。
story.en:
On the evening of the tenth day, the three of them reached the Zhang.

The Zhang was wider than the Si and muddier, yellow shot with green, no seeing the bottom; its surface lay so flat you could hardly tell it was flowing, except now and then an eddy turned over, spun once, and sank again.

A-He said "Wah", the little Zheng went "Aow" at the water, and Xiaoman wanted to say something too — but turning, he saw Zhou Heng standing on the bank, not moving.

Xiaoman said: "Brother Zhou?" Zhou Heng said: "Mm."

This time, for once, he did not say "put it on the account".

exits.means: goes to the town, follows the road, looks for an inn

story.zh: 邺城城池不小，街上却没什么人。说没人也不对，人都缩着：家家户户关着门，门缝里透出一双一双眼睛，瞧见他们三个外乡人，又一双一双地缩了回去。
story.en: Ye was no small city, yet its streets were nearly empty. Not empty, exactly — everyone was shrinking back: every door shut, pair after pair of eyes at the cracks, and at the sight of three strangers, pair after pair shrinking away again.

exits.means: tries to enter the river, swim, or reach what lies under it now

text.zh: 水没到膝盖就把你往下拽。周衡一把拉你回来：「天黑了，渡船要加钱。」
text.en: The water is at your knees and already pulling you down. Zhou Heng hauls you back: "It's getting dark — the ferry charges extra."

exits.means: asks about the river, the town, or the River Lord

text.zh: 周衡不答，只望着河心那一片最深、最黑的水。
text.en: Zhou Heng does not answer; he only looks at the deepest, darkest water mid-river.
